rows.title: Kesar Choker - Gold
rows.body_text_clean: Three textured gold flowers, each with an amethyst at its centre, are joined by curling tendrils, with chalcedony drops in pale aqua beneath. Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, on a slim snake chain with a slider to adjust the fit. A piece where florals are worked in layered petals rather than drawn flat.

rows.title: Tahr Bandhgala - Ivory
rows.body_text_clean: The Tahr Bandhgala, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, is cut in ivory linen and named for the tahr, the wild goat of the mountains. 100% linen, piece dyed in solid ivory, with full sleeves. A solid ivory jacket leaves a printed or coloured kurta underneath to carry the pattern.

rows.title: Bouquet Scarf - Pure Silk
rows.body_text_clean: A pure silk scarf named for the guldasta, or bouquet, printed all over in garden florals. Finished with a baby roll hemline, tassels at opposite corners, and mother-of-pearl buttons. Woven in 100% silk.

rows.title: Firefly Scarf - Grey & Gold
rows.body_text_clean: A Linen with Zari scarf in a grey and gold drawing on the collection's kalamkari-inspired garden motifs. Finished with a red star embroidered icon on one corner. Woven in alternate zari and linen stripes.

rows.title: Appu Cufflinks - Gold
rows.body_text_clean: Cufflinks shaped like seated elephants, named appu after the elephant that inspired them. Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, textured to bring out the folds of the ears and trunk. Small enough for a cuff, flamboyant enough to be the only accessory needed. For the shirt that could use a little personality at the wrist.

rows.title: Phool Jaal Earring - Gold
rows.body_text_clean: A lattice of flowers that falls like a net, jaal meaning exactly that, hence lending it its name: Phool Jaal. Handcrafted in brass, plated in gold and finished with pearl drops, adding a delicate detail. Each flower link is cut from sheet metal, joined so the whole thing moves as one.

rows.title: Pink Jade Drops - Gold
rows.body_text_clean: A drop earring built around a single cabochon, pink jade held by three small gold beads. Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, finished with a plain gold hook. Small and rounded, it merges at a single point of colour.

rows.title: Blush Sari - Metallic Tissue
rows.body_text_clean: The Blush Sari brings that feeling to pink metallic tissue, with a pallu striped in pink and silver. Made in metallic tissue, it has an easy, fluid drape. The body stays plain pink, and pink and silver stripes run across the pallu. A blue icon is embroidered at the pallu corner, with green bead tassels at both ends. Made for sangeets, festive dinners and celebrations.

rows.title: Strut Kaftan - Cotton Silk Free size
rows.body_text_clean: Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Strut Kaftan brings that spirit to a green polka foil print with a small embroidered detail at the collar. Cut in lightweight Cotton Silk, this free-size kaftan has an easy silhouette with a regular collar and half kaftan sleeves. Polka dots in foil sit across the green base, giving the classic motif a festive finish while keeping the overall look graphic and considered. The collar is finished with a red and aqua stone bug embroidery, with a concealed underplacket and a button stitched in fuchsia thread for a small flash of colour. Finished with a baby hem and an easy free-size fit, it is made for daytime festivities, mehendis and long lunches.

rows.title: Sashay Top - Metallised Fibre A-Line Fit
rows.body_text_clean: The Sashay Top brings a little evening shimmer to the collection in plum metallic tissue. Made in metallic tissue and fully lined, this A-line top has a deep V-neckline and straps that tie at the back of the neck. The back is open to the waist, closed with a single fabric shell button. A tiny red heart is embroidered near the hem. Wear it to a sangeet night or cocktail party.

rows.title: Tokyo offshoulder Top - Bemberg Relaxed
rows.body_text_clean: The Tokyo Off-Shoulder Top brings a flash of colour to the collection in red Bemberg, with one bare shoulder and a bow at the waist. Cut in Bemberg, a fibre made from cotton linter that drapes like silk and breathes like cotton, the top falls in soft folds across the front. A tie at the side waist gathers the drape and finishes in a long bow. Half sleeves with a turned-back cuff balance the open shoulder. A heart of blue and gold sequins sits on the back shoulder. Wear it with black trousers for cocktail evenings and dinners out.

rows.title: Vira Cocktail Glass - Set of 4
rows.body_text_clean: The Vira Cocktail Glass brings a spirited pop of colour to your bar cart, its glossy glass silhouette catching the light with every pour. Each glass in this set of four is finished in a vivid mix of colours, making them as much a design statement as they are a vessel for your favourite cocktail. Generously sized, they're built for everything from a classic mojito to a festive spiced cocktail, and look just as good holding a mocktail at a family gathering. A cheerful set to gift a friend who loves to entertain, or to elevate your own bar cart.

rows.title: Buransh Straight Mug
rows.body_text_clean: The buransh in full flower across a deep green base: pink rhododendron, white blossom and grey-green leaves wrapped around a straight-sided mug. Stoneware, with straight walls and a rounded handle, weighted enough to stay put on a desk. The dark base is forgiving of tea stains in a way a white mug rarely is.

rows.title: Bug Bracelet - Gold
rows.body_text_clean: NicoSera takes its name from the Italian word for evening, that golden hour when the day loosens its collar and the night begins. The Bug Bracelet brings a playful, jewel-like detail to after-dark dressing. Cast in brass and finished with 18k gold plating, the bracelet is accented with a polished onyx stone at its centre. A sculptural bug motif sits across the band, with intricate detailing and colourful accents that give the piece its character. Wear it as a statement piece with evening separates, or let it add an unexpected detail to a more pared-back look.

rows.title: Twilight Pocket Square - Set Of 2 - Blue
rows.body_text_clean: The Twilight Pocket Square Set brings a finishing touch to formal dressing, printed in bemberg with an abstract motif. Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that’s soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet. Sold as a set of two, each is finished with a smooth, lightweight handle. Perfect for weddings, formal dinners, and festive occasions it comes in a gift box.

rows.title: Alphabet- M Pin - Gold
rows.body_text_clean: A little personal touch for the everyday, the Alphabet- M Pin lets you carry your initial wherever you go. Handcrafted in brass with 18K gold plating, its clean letterform keeps the focus on simplicity. Small enough to pin onto a lapel, bag, or scarf, it makes for an easy everyday accent. Comes in a gift box

rows.title: Lola Slip - Cotton Regular Fit
rows.body_text_clean: An everyday foundation, elevated through intricate embroidery and considered finishing. Crafted from breathable cotton, it offers softness and comfort while remaining light enough for year-round wear. The all-over Madhumalti embroidery lends beautiful texture, balanced by a clean silhouette and adjustable straps for an effortless fit. Perfect beneath sheer styles or worn as a simple camisole with relaxed separates.

rows.title: Nova Charm - Black & Red

The Trapunto Star on Front and Heart on back and Metal zipper with red leather puller add a playful accent without overwhelming. An easy way to make an everyday favourite feel uniquely yours.

Whether used on its own or as part of the set, it's designed to keep your everyday favourites neatly together. Thoughtful, playful, and made to travel with you, it's a little reminder to carry comfort wherever you go.
